en: "We get to bully them?{w}Ufufu, I can hardly wait."{w}
"Not interested, I say!"{w}
"Professor Kamikaze, if you please."{w}
"Not the least bit interested, I say!!"{w}
"...It is in your advisor's contract.{w}I imagine sitting this out would affect your pay."{w}
"Wh-why, I'm bursting with interest!!"{w}
note: Kamikaze flips the moment pay is mentioned ([JP] = interest laid bare).

en:
"Well then, let us get ready.{w}This contest bears on the school's supplies. Since we're doing it,
we faculty will face you with everything we have."{w}{p}"Professor Scheherazade, is that thing ready?"{w}
note: [JP] = the school's supplies/stock: the bet is whether the school store carries the Caron brand.

en: "Thaaat hard, strong, big th-i-ng!{w}I get to call it out? Tee-hee...{w}Come forth, Tetramystica!!"{w}
note: [JP] spelled out as 'th-i-ng'; the innuendo of the source is kept. Tetramystica: new name (statue monster).

en: A mysterious stone statue appeared before you!{w}
"Now, Professor Kamikaze, your turn."{w}
"Honestly, what a slave driver of a woman.{w}...Here, Inugami! You're up!!"{w}
note: [JP] = a woman who works people hard (Kathleen; gender given by the line itself). Inugami: new name (Kamikaze's familiar).

en: Inugami appeared before you!{w}
"What's the matter?{w}Don't tell me you've lost your nerve... hm?"{w}
"I'll give you a good long torm... a good long cuddle!"{w}
note: [JP]…([JP]) cut off and replaced by [JP]: slip from 'torment' to 'cuddle' kept.

en:
"You seem to have gained experience in the outside world,
but will it hold up against us, I wonder?"{w}
"Don't give an old man too much trouble, eh?"{w}

"Then we teachers of Rubenburg shall show you
our power to the very last drop.{w}...We shall send you scattering!!"{w}
note: [JP] mirrored in the narration of 3381 ('sent ... scattering').

en: You sent the Rubenburg teachers scattering.{w}
"H-how can this be...!!"{w}
"Nooo, my little Tetra~"{w}
note: [JP] = pet form of Tetramystica.

en:
"Impossible...
To lose to such ridiculous equipment..."{w}
"Phew, that was exhausting."{w}

"It can't be helped. A promise is a promise.{w}Our school will carry the Caron brand."{w}{p}"I must go and pay my respects
to Caron later."{w}
note: [JP] -> 'Caron' (gender unknown, no Ms./Mr.).

en:
You proved that the Caron brand
has real practical value.{w}

"Step right up, step right up!
The Magical Party venue
is right this way!"{w}{p}"Just how far will your magic power
get you against Professor Nambino?{w}Anyone who wants in, step up one at a time~"{w}
note: Voice follows the Organizer in slice 042 (Rombino arena).

en: "I'll be waiting, so come and play anytime~"{w}
"And by the way, here's last time's winner!"{w}
"All right, go on in, one at a time!{w}Give it your all -- GO!"{w}
"Amazing, amazing! You're the winner!"{w}

note: Source ♪ -> '~'.

en: "Come and play again!"{w}

note: Nambino's gender unknown: 'the professor' instead of a pronoun.

en: Professor Nambino
note: Name box is 17 chars (limit ~16): glossary form kept; 'Prof. Nambino' if it does not fit.

en: Professor Nambino left.{w}
Professor Nambino left, looking dissatisfied.{w}
"Uuuuuugh..."{w}

Mirco was in front of you.{w}For some reason, he had his knees pressed together a little and one hand
on the wall, and a desperate look on his face.{w}
note: [JP] = slightly knock-kneed (he needs the toilet; see 38015).

en: "Ah, i-it's you guys..."{w}
His five companions didn't seem to be with him.{w}Something about him was different from usual.{w}
"Hehe...{w}Th-this time... I'll let you off..."{w}
"Hehe..."{w}

With an odd smile on his face,
Mirco backed away...{w}

Mirco squirmed the whole time he talked.{w}The way he looked at you was
just like a puppy drowning in a river.{w}
Give him the Angel's Window?
note: Prompt says give ([JP]); Mirco then begs to borrow it (3565): kept as in the source.

en: "P-please...{w}Lend it... lend it to me... please..."{w}
"Th... that's so mean..."{w}
"Waaaaaah..."{w}
Mirco left in tears.{w}
"R-really!?{w}Yaaaaay......!!"{w}
"I owe you one, thank you!!{w}I-I'm in a hurry, so that's all...{w}Bye!!"{w}
Mirco ran off at tremendous speed.{w}
"...Hey, what's with that brat?{w}Can kids that young even get in here?"{w}
"Who knows? ...But he's kinda cute, maybe!"{w}
"More like... is he holding it in for the john or something?"{w}
note: [JP] is blunt: 'the john'.

en: "Oh, maybe! Hang in there!!"{w}
"He ran off."{w}
"Can't say I don't know how he feels."{w}
"Oh dear..."{w}
"Poor guy."{w}

note: Multipliers are game data (the exam in slice 056 relies on them: 1.5x1.5x0.7x0.7 = 110%).

en:
"So you have come, new challengers.{w}Ahead lies the hall for the Year 2 Completion Exam."{w}{p}"But before that,
you must get past me."{w}{p}"As you can see, this is a no-spell floor.{w}Even a magic user will face times
when they must fight without spells."{w}{p}"But those who overcome such adversity
with wisdom are the truly wise.{w}Now, show me what you can do!"{w}
note: [JP] = 'Completion Exam' (new term).

en: "Very well, you pass!{w}Now, go and show me you can complete the 2nd year too!"{w}
"Oh, it's you.{w}Reading is all well and good, but get outside once in a while, eh?"{w}

"The Board Chair?{w}Hmm... but still..."{w}{p}"Whether a warrior should butt in
on matters between mages...{w}I'd like to help, but it's not my place."{w}{p}"Why not try asking Vice Principal Kathleen for help?"{w}
note: Gender of McMahon unknown: no pronoun for 'a warrior'.

en:
"I'm going to see Vice Principal Kathleen too!{w}But I want you to come as well,
Professor McMahon!"{w}
note: [JP] read as [JP] (visit). [JP] -> 'Professor McMahon' ([JP] = Professor per glossary). Source typo [JP] ignored.

en:
"So you've come, you young whelp!{w}Now then, shall I put that brain
of yours to the test!?"{w}
Take the Year 2 Completion Exam?
note: 34 chars; fallback 'Take the 2nd-Year Exam?' if the prompt box is short.

en: "Then here I come! Prepare yourself!!"{w}
"Nngh, you're good...{w}You pass! Take this!!"{w}

[Key Item]
You obtained the Year 2 Certificate.{w}
note: New key item name ([JP]).

en: "You are young!{w}Don't look back -- go where your heart leads you!!"{w}

"Fool!{w}You'd pass through the 2nd-year door with knowledge like that?
Don't make me laugh!!"{w}
note: [JP] -> 'Don't make me laugh'.

en: "Hah, lost your nerve, have you!?{w}Go on, then, and weep over how green you are!!"{w}
"...The Year 2 Completion Exam.{w}Begin."{w}

Special Advisor Kamikaze closed both eyes,
and an anti-cheating barrier went up.{w}
note: Avoids a pronoun for Kamikaze (gender unknown in glossary).

en:
When a party member has died,
is there a way to revive them 'for certain'?{w}
A way to revive 'for certain'?
Revive at a temple

note: Spell-name insert kept verbatim (answer option).
